errors.evidence: The description speculates on the meaning of the x-axis units by stating it 'probably reflects a relative value or index'. This is a minor interpretation, as the caption already specifies the values are 'average ratings' ('средни оценки'). While not strictly incorrect, it is an unnecessary interpretation beyond what is explicitly stated.
